b_only.addressee: Shipping companies operating containerships of 10,000 TEU and above
b_only.benefit_or_duty: 0.9 million allowances per year (until 2035) are set aside to fund maritime-sector decarbonisation projects in least developed countries and small island developing states.

b_only.addressee: Aircraft operators flying to/from eligible LDCs/SIDS
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Surrender allowances under Art. 12(3) for emissions from flights to or from listed LDC/SIDS states.

b_only.addressee: Commission/Member States administering the Market Stability Reserve
b_only.benefit_or_duty: The Market Stability Reserve release thresholds (400 million / 300 million allowances, 100 million release amount) that return allowances to auction also tighten by 4% each year from 2029, restricting the supply released back to the market

b_registered.addressee: Aircraft operators flying between aerodromes in the same outermost region or Member State
b_registered.benefit_or_duty: Comply with the surrender, monitoring, reporting and registry requirements of the EU ETS for emissions from flights between an aerodrome in an outermost region and another aerodrome in the same Member State.

b_registered.addressee: Aircraft operators subject to CORSIA offsetting
b_registered.benefit_or_duty: Aircraft operators must cancel their notified quantity of CORSIA-eligible units by fixed statutory deadlines for each CORSIA compliance period
